summary: Tested Queda (SafeSpend) Expo web preview end-to-end. Onboarding (3 slides Spanish, 'Calcular mi dinero seguro' CTA), setup wizard (8 steps incl. currency, bills toggle, skip on bills/goal), Home (safe-spend number, status pill, cycle progress, 4 quick actions, upcoming payments), Add-Expense (saves and reduces safe-spend from $107.14 to $103.57), Can-I-Buy (simulator with result card), Premium tab (Free/Pro/Plus with Activar/Plan actual tag), Settings (premium pills, language picker, currency, reset dialog), Calendar (month grid, prev/next, 30-day projection paywall), Envelopes (empty state with add btn), Expenses tab (filters, list, totals), and Reports — ALL render and basic interactions work. Paywall modal correctly opens on the locked Calendar projection card for Free users and disappears after activating Plus. ONE CRITICAL BUG: AsyncStorage persistence is broken — after completing setup and reloading, the app returns to /onboarding instead of /(tabs). Root cause: race condition in AppDataContext.mutate() — it awaits persist(next) before React has executed setData's updater, so `next` is undefined when persisted, writing the literal string 'undefined' to storage.

ui_bugs.issue: Persistence broken: localStorage['queda:app_data:v1'] becomes the string 'undefined' after the setup wizard finishes. On reload the app re-routes to /onboarding instead of /(tabs). Reference: /app/frontend/src/store/AppDataContext.tsx:135-150. `await persist(next)` runs before React executes the setData updater that assigns `next`, so JSON.stringify(undefined) is stored.

Concatenated Spanish copy reads awkwardly: 'Te quedan $1,500.00 días hasta cobrar (14)'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:56-59. Suggest: `${t('home.moneyLeft')} ${formatMoney(...)} · ${daysLeft} ${t('home.daysLeft')}`.

textTransform: 'capitalize' applied to es-ES dates produces 'Lunes, 25 De Mayo' and 'Mayo De 2026' — Spanish prepositions like 'de' should stay lowercase. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:266 (dateStr) and calendar header.
Tabs (Inicio/Gastos/Calendario/Sobres/Premium) have no testID props on the tab buttons, forcing tests to use brittle text selectors. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx

integration_issues.issue: After completing setup the in-memory app state is correct (Home displays $107.14 safe-spend, $1500 balance) but storage saves 'undefined'. Reloading sends the user back to onboarding — onboardingCompleted/setupCompleted flags are lost.

issues: Hero friendly line is grammatically awkward (see ui_bugs)
Capitalized 'De' inside dates ('Mayo De 2026', '25 De Mayo')

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Appears during navigation. Likely emitted by a third-party RN component using the legacy prop. Not a blocker but should be tracked.

action_items: FIX (CRITICAL): Make AppDataContext.mutate persist the computed next state reliably. Recommended pattern: compute next from a ref instead of via setData callback. Example: `const next = updater(dataRef.current); dataRef.current = next; setData(next); await persist(next);` This also avoids stale-state issues when several mutates fire in sequence (setup wizard finish, add-expense, premium toggle, etc.).

FIX: Reword home friendly copy or change translation key to avoid the ugly 'moneyLeft + amount + daysLeft + (n)' concatenation. Example translation key with placeholder support, or change the template to `${t('home.moneyLeft')} ${formatMoney(amount)} · ${daysLeft} ${t('home.daysLeft')}`.
FIX: Remove `textTransform: 'capitalize'` from date Text styles in (tabs)/index.tsx and the calendar header, or build the date string manually so Spanish 'de' stays lowercase.
ADD: testID props to each tab in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx (e.g. tab-home, tab-expenses, tab-calendar, tab-envelopes, tab-premium) for stable test selectors.
INVESTIGATE: pointerEvents deprecation warning — usually fixed by upgrading the dependency emitting it (gesture-handler / safe-area / etc.) or by patching local usage.
critical_code_review_comments: AppDataContext.mutate uses `let next!: AppData` and assigns it inside the setData callback, then immediately awaits persist(next). In React 18 setState updaters may not execute synchronously when called from async non-event code, so persist receives undefined. This is the root cause of the persistence regression.

storage.setItem internally JSON.stringifies its argument. AppDataContext.persist passes JSON.stringify(next), causing a double-stringify on disk. Works (the loader JSON.parses twice via retrieve+JSON.parse) but is wasteful; consider letting storage handle a single JSON encode.
(tabs)/_layout.tsx tabs lack testIDs — limits test stability.
Onboarding `onScroll` updates `page` but uses a captured `width` from initial mount — not a real bug on web preview but could break if window resizes.

success_rate.frontend: ~88% (12/14 scenarios pass; persistence + minor copy issues fail)

seed_data_creation: None — all data created via in-app flows (setup wizard, add-expense, premium toggle).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use mobile viewport 390x844. Public URL: https://daily-spend-calc-2.preview.emergentagent.com. AsyncStorage on web is backed by localStorage (key: 'queda:app_data:v1'). Reproduce persistence bug: complete onboarding (3x onboarding-next-btn) → setup wizard (balance/currency/payday/income/frequency/bills-skip/goal-skip/done) → reload → user is back on /onboarding. Inspect localStorage to see value 'undefined'. After fix, verify reload lands directly on /(tabs) and shows persisted safe-spend number. Add-expense testIDs are `add-expense-name`, `add-expense-amount`, `add-expense-save` (no `-input`/`-btn` suffix). Can-I-Buy testIDs: `can-i-buy-name`, `can-i-buy-amount`, `can-i-buy-simulate`. Premium activation: `plan-card-pro-activate`, `plan-card-plus-activate`. Settings plan pills: `settings-plan-free|pro|plus`. Reset: `settings-reset-btn` → `confirm-dialog-confirm`. Paywall: `paywall-modal`, `paywall-upgrade-btn`, `paywall-later-btn`.
rca_of_issue: BUG: persistence loss after reload. STEPS: complete onboarding+setup (any inputs) → reload page → app shows /onboarding again. RCA: in /app/frontend/src/store/AppDataContext.tsx the mutate() helper declares `let next!: AppData`, assigns inside the setData updater, then calls `await persist(next)`. Because setData's updater is deferred by React, `next` is still undefined when persist runs. storage.setItem(key, undefined) writes the literal string 'undefined' to localStorage. On next load the loader sees a non-null raw string `'undefined'`, JSON.parse fails (caught silently), falls back to defaults → onboarding. MITIGATION: compute next synchronously before setData using a ref (or by calling the updater on a snapshot), then setData and persist using that ref. Pseudocode in action_items above.
